verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim is itself a simulation sandbox (USD/PhysX-based) that lets users import robots/scenes, generate synthetic data, and validate ROS 2 stacks entirely in simulation before touching real/production hardware or data, and Isaac Lab explicitly supports headless, GPU-accelerated training environments separate from deployment. missing for 10: no explicit documentation contrasting sandbox vs production data pipelines, no independent hands-on report confirming isolation guarantees, and no mention of data governance/access controls between sim and prod environments.
